probe_scope: Pure helper execution with synthetic inputs; candidate ranking implication follows from the inspected lexicographic score. This is not a new route solve or travel-risk forecast.

findings.finding: Missing weather_risk defaults to zero in local repair scoring.
findings.implication: Among otherwise feasible candidates, unknown risk can rank ahead of a positive known score.

findings.finding: Whole-trip MILP has no quantitative weather-risk objective term.
findings.implication: It minimizes travel and optional-stop/interest penalties after bounded exclusions and validation; it does not establish minimum trip risk.

findings.finding: Weather-risk delta requires complete numeric fields and identical selected stop-ID sets.
findings.implication: The metric can be unavailable after replacing a stop, even when both plans have risk values.

findings.finding: PASSED certification does not require complete numeric weather-risk coverage.
findings.implication: It confirms the configured checks, not a calibrated probability of safe travel.

recorded_preview.evidence_scope: Retained synthetic preview from the same source build; no current-weather claim.
